sources.title: How to Use the Detectron2 Model Zoo for Object Detection
sources.snippet: The Detectron2 model zoo is a catalog of pre-trained checkpoints for object detection, instance segmentation, keypoint detection, and panoptic segmentation, built on PyTorch by Facebook AI Research. Every model in the zoo is described by a config file whose name doubles as the key for downloading its weights, so swapping architectures in a training script is a one-string change.
